@dataclass
class Position:
    x: float = 0.0
    y: float = 0.0
    z: float = 0.0

    def distance_to(self, other: 'Position') -> float:
        return math.sqrt((self.x - other.x)**2 + (self.y - other.y)**2 + (self.z - other.z)**2)

    def __add__(self, other: 'Position') -> 'Position':
        return Position(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y, self.z + other.z)

    def __sub__(self, other: 'Position') -> 'Position':
        return Position(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y, self.z - other.z)

@dataclass
class Robot:
    id: str
    team: Team
    robot_type: RobotType
    health: float = 100.0
    max_health: float = 100.0
    shield: float = 0.0
    max_shield: float = 50.0
    position: Position = field(default_factory=Position)
    velocity: Position = field(default_factory=Position)
    weapon: WeaponType = WeaponType.PULSE_RIFLE
    ability_cooldown: Dict[AbilityType, float] = field(default_factory=dict)
    inventory: List[PowerUpType] = field(default_factory=list)
    score: int = 0
    team_bonus: int = 0
    alive: bool = True
    role: str = "default"
    last_action_time: float = 0.0
    target: Optional[str] = None
    strategy_memory: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    weapon_ammo: Dict[WeaponType, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    experience: float = 0.0

    def __post_init__(self):
        # Initialize weapon ammo
        self.weapon_ammo = {
            WeaponType.PULSE_RIFLE: 100,
            WeaponType.SHOTGUN: 12,
            WeaponType.PLASMA_CANNON: 20,
            WeaponType.MISSILE_LAUNCHER: 5,
            WeaponType.SNIPER_RIFLE: 10,
        }
        # Initialize cooldowns
        self.ability_cooldown = {ability: 0.0 for ability in AbilityType}
        
    def take_damage(self, damage: float) -> bool:
        """Apply damage to robot, considering shield first."""
        if not self.alive:
            return False
            
        # Shield absorbs damage first
        if self.shield > 0:
            shield_absorbed = min(damage, self.shield)
            self.shield -= shield_absorbed
            damage -= shield_absorbed
            
        # Apply remaining damage to health
        self.health = max(0, self.health - damage)
        
        if self.health <= 0:
            self.alive = False
            logger.info(f"Robot {self.id} ({self.team.value}) has been destroyed!")
            
        return self.alive
        
    def heal(self, amount: float):
        """Heal robot, respecting max health."""
        self.health = min(self.max_health, self.health + amount)
        
    def recharge_shield(self, amount: float):
        """Recharge shield, respecting max shield."""
        self.shield = min(self.max_shield, self.shield + amount)
        
    def use_ability(self, ability: AbilityType) -> bool:
        """Use ability if on cooldown."""
        if self.ability_cooldown[ability] > 0:
            return False
            
        # Reset cooldown for this ability
        cooldown_map = {
            AbilityType.HEAL: 15.0,
            AbilityType.BOOST: 20.0,
            AbilityType.SHIELD: 30.0,
            AbilityType.SAM_SITE: 45.0,
            AbilityType.TELEPORT: 60.0,
            AbilityType.HOLOGRAM: 25.0,
        }
        
        self.ability_cooldown[ability] = cooldown_map[ability]
        logger.info(f"Robot {self.id} used {ability.value}")
        return True
        
    def update_cooldowns(self, delta_time: float):
        """Update all ability cooldowns."""
        for ability in self.ability_cooldown:
            if self.ability_cooldown[ability] > 0:
                self.ability_cooldown[ability] = max(0, self.ability_cooldown[ability] - delta_time)
                
    def add_experience(self, xp: float):
        """Add experience and potentially level up."""
        self.experience += xp
        # Experience required for level up increases with level
        level_up_threshold = 100 + (self.experience // 100) * 50
        if self.experience >= level_up_threshold:
            self.level_up()
            
    def level_up(self):
        """Level up robot, improving stats."""
        self.max_health += 10
        self.max_shield += 5
        self.health = self.max_health
        self.shield = self.max_shield
        logger.info(f"Robot {self.id} leveled up! Health: {self.max_health}, Shield: {self.max_shield}")

class AIController:
    """Handles AI decision-making for robots."""
    
    def __init__(self, game_state: GameState, robots: Dict[str, Robot]):
        self.game_state = game_state
        self.robots = robots
        self.difficulty_level = 1.0  # 1.0 = Normal, >1.0 = Harder

    def update_difficulty(self):
        """Adjust difficulty based on team performance."""
        red_score = self.game_state.score[Team.RED]

        if red_score > blue_score * 2:

        nearest_enemy = self.find_nearest_enemy(robot)

        if robot.health < robot.max_health * 0.3:

        # If robot has a shield and it's low, recharge
        if robot.shield < robot.max_shield * 0.2 and robot.ability_cooldown[AbilityType.SHIELD] <= 0:
            return "USE_SHIELD"
            
        # If team is winning, play defensively
        if self.game_state.score[robot.team] > self.game_state.score[robot.team.opposite()]:
            if nearest_objective and nearest_objective.team == robot.team:

        # If team is losing, play aggressively

            if delta_time > 0.1:

    MINEFIELD = "Minefield"

@dataclass
class Position:
    x: float = 0.0
    y: float = 0.0
    z: float = 0.0

    def distance_to(self, other: 'Position') -> float:
        return math.sqrt((self.x - other.x)**2 + (self.y - other.y)**2 + (self.z - other.z)**2)

    def __add__(self, other: 'Position') -> 'Position':
        return Position(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y, self.z + other.z)

    def __sub__(self, other: 'Position') -> 'Position':
        return Position(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y, self.z - other.z)

@dataclass
class Robot:
    id: str
    team: Team
    robot_type: RobotType
    health: float = 100.0
    max_health: float = 100.0
    shield: float = 0.0
    max_shield: float = 50.0
    position: Position = field(default_factory=Position)
    velocity: Position = field(default_factory=Position)
    weapon: WeaponType = WeaponType.PULSE_RIFLE
    ability_cooldown: Dict[AbilityType, float] = field(default_factory=dict)
    inventory: List[PowerUpType] = field(default_factory=list)
    score: int = 0
    team_bonus: int = 0
    alive: bool = True
    role: str = "default"
    last_action_time: float = 0.0
    target: Optional[str] = None
    strategy_memory: List[Dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    weapon_ammo: Dict[WeaponType, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    experience: float = 0.0

    def __post_init__(self):
        # Initialize weapon ammo
        self.weapon_ammo = {
            WeaponType.PULSE_RIFLE: 100,
            WeaponType.SHOTGUN: 12,
            WeaponType.PLASMA_CANNON: 20,
            WeaponType.MISSILE_LAUNCHER: 5,
            WeaponType.SNIPER_RIFLE: 10,
        }
        # Initialize cooldowns
        self.ability_cooldown = {ability: 0.0 for ability in AbilityType}
        
    def take_damage(self, damage: float) -> bool:
        """Apply damage to robot, considering shield first."""
        if not self.alive:
            return False
            
        # Shield absorbs damage first
        if self.shield > 0:
            shield_absorbed = min(damage, self.shield)
            self.shield -= shield_absorbed
            damage -= shield_absorbed
            
        # Apply remaining damage to health
        self.health = max(0, self.health - damage)
        
        if self.health <= 0:
            self.alive = False
            logger.info(f"Robot {self.id} ({self.team.value}) has been destroyed!")
            
        return self.alive
        
    def heal(self, amount: float):
        """Heal robot, respecting max health."""
        self.health = min(self.max_health, self.health + amount)
        
    def recharge_shield(self, amount: float):
        """Recharge shield, respecting max shield."""
        self.shield = min(self.max_shield, self.shield + amount)
        
    def use_ability(self, ability: AbilityType) -> bool:
        """Use ability if on cooldown."""
        if self.ability_cooldown[ability] > 0:
            return False
            
        # Reset cooldown for this ability
        cooldown_map = {
            AbilityType.HEAL: 15.0,
            AbilityType.BOOST: 20.0,
            AbilityType.SHIELD: 30.0,
            AbilityType.SAM_SITE: 45.0,
            AbilityType.TELEPORT: 60.0,
            AbilityType.HOLOGRAM: 25.0,
        }
        
        self.ability_cooldown[ability] = cooldown_map[ability]
        logger.info(f"Robot {self.id} used {ability.value}")
        return True
        
    def update_cooldowns(self, delta_time: float):
        """Update all ability cooldowns."""
        for ability in self.ability_cooldown:
            if self.ability_cooldown[ability] > 0:
                self.ability_cooldown[ability] = max(0, self.ability_cooldown[ability] - delta_time)
                
    def add_experience(self, xp: float):
        """Add experience and potentially level up."""
        self.experience += xp
        # Experience required for level up increases with level
        level_up_threshold = 100 + (self.experience // 100) * 50
        if self.experience >= level_up_threshold:
            self.level_up()
            
    def level_up(self):
        """Level up robot, improving stats."""
        self.max_health += 10
        self.max_shield += 5
        self.health = self.max_health
        self.shield = self.max_shield
        logger.info(f"Robot {self.id} leveled up! Health: {self.max_health}, Shield: {self.max_shield}")

class AIController:
    """Handles AI decision-making for robots."""
    
    def __init__(self, game_state: GameState, robots: Dict[str, Robot]):
        self.game_state = game_state
        self.robots = robots
        self.difficulty_level = 1.0  # 1.0 = Normal, >1.0 = Harder
        self.performance_history = deque(maxlen=100)  # Track recent performance
        
    def update_difficulty(self):
        """Adjust difficulty based on team performance."""
        red_score = self.game_state.score[Team.RED]
        blue_score = self.game_state.score[Team.BLUE]
        
        # If one team is dominating, increase difficulty for them
        if red_score > blue_score * 2:
            self.difficulty_level = min(2.0, self.difficulty_level + 0.1)
            logger.info(f"Difficulty increased to {self.difficulty_level} (Blue team struggling)")
        elif blue_score > red_score * 2:
            self.difficulty_level = min(2.0, self.difficulty_level + 0.1)
            logger.info(f"Difficulty increased to {self.difficulty_level} (Red team struggling)")
        else:
            # Gradually decrease difficulty if teams are balanced
            self.difficulty_level = max(0.5, self.difficulty_level - 0.01)
            
    def get_robot_strategy(self, robot: Robot) -> str:
        """Determine optimal strategy for a robot based on context."""
        
        # Analyze current game state
        nearest_objective = self.find_nearest_objective(robot)
        nearest_enemy = self.find_nearest_enemy(robot)
        teammates = self.find_teammates(robot)
        
        # If robot is low on health, prioritize healing
        if robot.health < robot.max_health * 0.3:
            return "HEAL"
            
        # If robot has a shield and it's low, recharge
        if robot.shield < robot.max_shield * 0.2 and robot.ability_cooldown[AbilityType.SHIELD] <= 0:
            return "USE_SHIELD"
            
        # If team is winning, play defensively
        if self.game_state.score[robot.team] > self.game_state.score[robot.team.opposite()]:
            if nearest_objective and nearest_objective.team == robot.team:
                return "DEFEND_OBJECTIVE"
                
        # If team is losing, play aggressively
        if self.game_state.score[robot.team] < self.game_state.score[robot.team.opposite()]:
            if nearest_objective and nearest_objective.team != robot.team:
                return "CAPTURE_OBJECTIVE"
                
        # Default behavior based on robot type
        if robot.robot_type == RobotType.ASSAULT:
            return "ATTACK_ENEMY" if nearest_enemy else "PATROL"
        elif robot.robot_type == RobotType.SUPPORT:
            return "HEAL_TEAMMATES" if teammates else "PATROL"
        elif robot.robot_type == RobotType.SCOUT:
            return "RECON" if nearest_enemy else "PATROL"
        elif robot.robot_type == RobotType.TANK:
            return "TANK" if nearest_enemy else "PATROL"
            
        return "PATROL"
        
    def find_nearest_objective(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[Objective]:
        """Find the nearest objective to the robot."""
        nearest = None
        min_distance = float('inf')
        
        for obj in self.game_state.objectives:
            distance = robot.position.distance_to(obj.position)
            if distance < min_distance:
                min_distance = distance
                nearest = obj
                
        return nearest if min_distance < 50 else None
        
    def find_nearest_enemy(self, robot: Robot) -> Optional[Robot]:
        """Find the nearest enemy robot."""
        nearest = None
        min_distance = float('inf')
        
        for other_robot in self.robots.values():
            if other_robot.team != robot.team and other_robot.alive:
                distance = robot.position.distance_to(other_robot.position)
                if distance < min_distance:
                    min_distance = distance
                    nearest = other_robot
                    
        return nearest
        
    def find_teammates(self, robot: Robot) -> List[Robot]:
        """Find all alive teammates."""
        return [r for r in self.robots.values() 
                if r.team == robot.team and r.alive and r.id != robot.id]
                
    def make_decision(self, robot: Robot) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Generate a decision for the robot based on current state."""
        
        # Update difficulty based on performance
        self.update_difficulty()
        
        # Get strategy
        strategy = self.get_robot_strategy(robot)
        
        # Use performance history to adapt behavior
        if len(self.performance_history) > 10:
            # If robot has been performing poorly, try more aggressive tactics
            recent_performance = sum(1 for item in list(self.performance_history)[-10:] 
                                   if item.get('success', False))
            if recent_performance < 3:  # Less than 30% success rate
                if strategy == "PATROL":
                    strategy = "ATTACK_ENEMY"
                elif strategy == "HEAL_TEAMMATES":
                    strategy = "CAPTURE_OBJECTIVE"
                
        # Adjust decision based on difficulty level
        if self.difficulty_level > 1.5:
            # Harder AI: more aggressive, better coordination
            if strategy == "PATROL":
                strategy = "ATTACK_ENEMY"
            elif strategy == "HEAL_TEAMMATES":
                # Hard AI will prioritize objectives even when healing
                if self.find_nearest_objective(robot):
                    strategy = "CAPTURE_OBJECTIVE"
                    
        # Generate specific action based on strategy
        action = {
            "strategy": strategy,
            "target": None,
            "movement": "MOVE",
            "weapon": robot.weapon,
            "ability": None,
            "priority": 1
        }
        
        # Set target based on strategy
        if strategy == "ATTACK_ENEMY":
            enemy = self.find_nearest_enemy(robot)
            if enemy:
                action["target"] = enemy.id
                action["priority"] = 5
                
        elif strategy == "CAPTURE_OBJECTIVE":
            objective = self.find_nearest_objective(robot)
            if objective and objective.team != robot.team:
                action["target"] = f"objective_{objective.type.value}"
                action["priority"] = 4
                
        elif strategy == "DEFEND_OBJECTIVE":
            objective = self.find_nearest_objective(robot)
            if objective and objective.team == robot.team:
                action["target"] = f"objective_{objective.type.value}"
                action["priority"] = 4
                
        elif strategy == "HEAL_TEAMMATES":
            teammates = self.find_teammates(robot)
            low_health_teammates = [t for t in teammates if t.health < t.max_health * 0.5]
            if low_health_teammates:
                closest = min(low_health_teammates, key=lambda t: robot.position.distance_to(t.position))
                action["target"] = closest.id
                action["ability"] = AbilityType.HEAL
                action["priority"] = 5
                
        elif strategy == "USE_SHIELD":
            action["ability"] = AbilityType.SHIELD
            action["priority"] = 5
            
        elif strategy == "RECON":
            enemy = self.find_nearest_enemy(robot)
            if enemy:
                action["target"] = enemy.id
                action["priority"] = 3
                
        elif strategy == "TANK":
            enemy = self.find_nearest_enemy(robot)
            if enemy:
                action["target"] = enemy.id
                action["priority"] = 5
                
        # Add ability usage if appropriate and available
        if strategy == "HEAL_TEAMMATES" and robot.ability_cooldown[AbilityType.HEAL] <= 0:
            action["ability"] = AbilityType.HEAL
            
        if strategy == "USE_SHIELD" and robot.ability_cooldown[AbilityType.SHIELD] <= 0:
            action["ability"] = AbilityType.SHIELD
            
        # Add weapon changes based on distance to target
        if action["target"]:
            target_robot = self.robots.get(action["target"]) if action["target"].startswith("r_") else None
            if target_robot:
                distance = robot.position.distance_to(target_robot.position)
                if distance > 30:
                    # Use long-range weapon
                    if robot.weapon != WeaponType.SNIPER_RIFLE:
                        if robot.weapon_ammo[WeaponType.SNIPER_RIFLE] > 0:
                            action["weapon"] = WeaponType.SNIPER_RIFLE
                elif distance < 10:
                    # Use melee if available
                    if robot.weapon != WeaponType.LASER_SWORD:
                        # Check if robot type allows melee
                        if robot.robot_type == RobotType.ASSAULT:
                            action["weapon"] = WeaponType.LASER_SWORD
            
        # Add movement command
        if action["target"]:
            target_pos = None
            # If target is an enemy robot
            if action["target"] in self.robots:
                target_robot = self.robots[action["target"]]
                if target_robot.alive:
                    target_pos = target_robot.position
            # If target is an objective
            elif action["target"].startswith("objective_"):
                for obj in self.game_state.objectives:
                    if f"objective_{obj.type.value}" == action["target"]:
                        target_pos = obj.position
                        break
                        
            if target_pos:
                # Move toward target
                direction = target_pos - robot.position
                if direction.x == 0 and direction.y == 0 and direction.z == 0:
                    direction = Position(random.uniform(-1, 1), random.uniform(-1, 1), 0)
                # Normalize direction
                magnitude = math.sqrt(direction.x**2 + direction.y**2 + direction.z**2)
                if magnitude > 0:
                    direction.x /= magnitude
                    direction.y /= magnitude
                    direction.z /= magnitude
                action["movement"] = "MOVE_TOWARD"
                action["target_position"] = target_pos
                action["speed"] = 1.0 + (self.difficulty_level - 1.0) * 0.5
                
        # Add some randomness for unpredictability
        if random.random() < 0.1 * self.difficulty_level:
            # Add random ability usage
            abilities = [a for a in AbilityType if robot.ability_cooldown[a] <= 0]
            if abilities:
                action["ability"] = random.choice(abilities)
                
        return action
        
    def update_performance_history(self, robot_id: str, success: bool):
        """Record robot performance for adaptive learning."""
        self.performance_history.append({
            "robot_id": robot_id,
            "success": success,
            "timestamp": time.time()
        })
        
    def adapt_strategy(self, robot: Robot, previous_action: Dict[str, Any], outcome: Dict[str, Any]):
        """Update robot's strategy memory based on outcome."""
        # Add to memory
        robot.strategy_memory.append({
            "action": previous_action,
            "outcome": outcome,
            "timestamp": time.time()
        })
        
        # Prune old memory
        if len(robot.strategy_memory) > 50:
            robot.strategy_memory.pop(0)
            
        # Learn from experience - if action failed, avoid similar actions
        if not outcome.get("success", False):
            # Slightly reduce likelihood of repeating the same strategy
            # This is a simplified learning mechanism
            pass
            
        # Increase experience for successful actions
        if outcome.get("success", False):
            robot.add_experience(5.0)

class CyberArena:
    """Main game engine for CyberArena."""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.robots: Dict[str, Robot] = {}
        self.game_state = GameState()
        self.ai_controller = AIController(self.game_state, self.robots)
        self.running = False
        self.simulation_thread = None
        self.command_queue = queue.Queue()
        self.last_frame_time = time.time()
        self.frame_interval = 1.0 / 60.0  # 60 FPS
        
        # Initialize environment
        self.initialize_environment()
        
        # Initialize robots
        self.initialize_robots()
        
        # Sound and visual effects (simulated)
        self.sound_effects = {
            "shoot": "PULSE_SHOOT",
            "explosion": "EXPLOSION",
            "heal": "HEAL_SOUND",
            "powerup": "POWERUP_SOUND",
            "objective_complete": "OBJECTIVE_COMPLETE"
        }
        
        self.particle_effects = []
        
    def initialize_environment(self):
        """Initialize the arena environment with objectives, power-ups, and hazards."""
        # Create objectives
        objective_positions = [
            Position(50, 50, 0),
            Position(-50, -50, 0),
            Position(0, 80, 0),
            Position(0, -80, 0)
        ]
        
        for i, pos in enumerate(objective_positions):
            # Alternate objectives between teams
            team = Team.RED if i % 2 == 0 else Team.BLUE
            obj_type = random.choice([ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE, ObjectiveType.CONTROL_POINT])
            objective = Objective(
                type=obj_type,
                position=pos,
                team=team,
                capture_radius=15.0,
                time_required=15.0
            )
            self.game_state.objectives.append(objective)
            
        # Create power-ups
        powerup_positions = [
            Position(30, 30, 0),
            Position(-30, -30, 0),
            Position(70, 20, 0),
            Position(-70, -20, 0),
            Position(0, 0, 0)
        ]
        
        powerup_types = [
            PowerUpType.HEALTH_PACK,
            PowerUpType.AMMO_RELOAD,
            PowerUpType.SPEED_BOOST,
            PowerUpType.DAMAGE_BOOST,
            PowerUpType.INVINCIBILITY
        ]
        
        for pos in powerup_positions:
            powerup = PowerUp(
                type=random.choice(powerup_types),
                position=pos,
                respawn_time=30.0,
                time_left=30.0
            )
            self.game_state.power_ups.append(powerup)
            
        # Create environmental hazards
        hazard_positions = [
            Position(20, 0, 0),
            Position(-20, 0, 0),
            Position(0, 40, 0),
            Position(0, -40, 0)
        ]
        
        hazard_types = [
            EnvironmentHazard.ELECTRIC_FIELD,
            EnvironmentHazard.LAVA_POOL,
            EnvironmentHazard.TOXIC_GAS,
            EnvironmentHazard.MINEFIELD
        ]
        
        for pos in hazard_positions:
            hazard = EnvironmentHazardInstance(
                type=random.choice(hazard_types),
                position=pos,
                radius=8.0,
                damage_per_second=3.0
            )
            self.game_state.hazards.append(hazard)
            
        logger.info(f"Environment initialized with {len(self.game_state.objectives)} objectives, "
                   f"{len(self.game_state.power_ups)} power-ups, and {len(self.game_state.hazards)} hazards.")
        
    def initialize_robots(self):
        """Initialize robots with balanced team composition."""
        # Create 12 robots - 6 per team
        robot_types = [RobotType.ASSAULT, RobotType.SUPPORT, RobotType.SCOUT, RobotType.TANK]
        
        # Team Red
        for i in range(6):
            robot_type = robot_types[i % len(robot_types)]
            robot = Robot(
                id=f"r_red_{i}",
                team=Team.RED,
                robot_type=robot_type,
                position=Position(random.uniform(-80, -20), random.uniform(-70, 70), 0)
            )
            self.robots[robot.id] = robot
            
        # Team Blue
        for i in range(6):
            robot_type = robot_types[i % len(robot_types)]
            robot = Robot(
                id=f"r_blue_{i}",
                team=Team.BLUE,
                robot_type=robot_type,
                position=Position(random.uniform(20, 80), random.uniform(-70, 70), 0)
            )
            self.robots[robot.id] = robot
            
        logger.info(f"Initialized {len(self.robots)} robots: {len([r for r in self.robots.values() if r.team == Team.RED])} Red, {len([r for r in self.robots.values() if r.team == Team.BLUE])} Blue")
        
    def start(self):
        """Start the game simulation."""
        if self.running:
            return
            
        self.running = True
        self.game_state.round_started = True
        self.game_state.last_update = time.time()
        
        # Start simulation thread
        self.simulation_thread = threading.Thread(target=self._simulation_loop)
        self.simulation_thread.daemon = True
        self.simulation_thread.start()
        
        logger.info("CyberArena simulation started.")
        
    def stop(self):
        """Stop the game simulation."""
        self.running = False
        if self.simulation_thread:
            self.simulation_thread.join(timeout=1.0)
        logger.info("CyberArena simulation stopped.")
        
    def _simulation_loop(self):
        """Main simulation loop."""
        while self.running:
            current_time = time.time()
            delta_time = current_time - self.last_frame_time
            self.last_frame_time = current_time
            
            # Cap delta_time to prevent large jumps
            if delta_time > 0.1:
                delta_time = 0.1
                
            # Update game state
            self.update(delta_time)
            
            # Sleep to maintain frame rate
            elapsed = time.time() - current_time
            sleep_time = self.frame_interval - elapsed
            if sleep_time > 0:
                time.sleep(sleep_time)
                
    def update(self, delta_time: float):
        """Update game state for the current frame."""
        # Update time
        self.game_state.time_elapsed += delta_time
        
        # Update robot cooldowns
        for robot in self.robots.values():
            if robot.alive:
                robot.update_cooldowns(delta_time)
                
        # Update power-ups
        for powerup in self.game_state.power_ups:
            if powerup.active:
                powerup.time_left -= delta_time
                if powerup.time_left <= 0:
                    powerup.active = False
            else:
                powerup.respawn_time -= delta_time
                if powerup.respawn_time <= 0:
                    powerup.active = True
                    powerup.respawn_time = 30.0
                    powerup.time_left = 30.0
                    # Create visual effect
                    self.particle_effects.append({
                        "type": "powerup_spawn",
                        "position": powerup.position,
                        "lifetime": 2.0
                    })
                    
        # Update hazards
        for hazard in self.game_state.hazards:
            if hazard.active:
                # Apply damage to robots in hazard area
                for robot in self.robots.values():
                    if robot.alive and robot.position.distance_to(hazard.position) <= hazard.radius:
                        robot.take_damage(hazard.damage_per_second * delta_time)
                        # Create visual effect
                        self.particle_effects.append({
                            "type": "hazard_damage",
                            "position": robot.position,
                            "lifetime": 1.0
                        })
                        
        # Process AI decisions
        for robot in self.robots.values():
            if robot.alive and robot.team != Team.NEUTRAL:  # Only AI-controlled robots
                # Get action from AI
                action = self.ai_controller.make_decision(robot)
                
                # Execute action
                outcome = self.execute_action(robot, action)
                
                # Update performance history
                self.ai_controller.update_performance_history(robot.id, outcome.get("success", False))
                
                # Adapt robot strategy based on outcome
                self.ai_controller.adapt_strategy(robot, action, outcome)
                
        # Process objectives
        self.update_objectives(delta_time)
        
        # Update scoring
        self.update_scoring()
        
        # Update visual and audio effects (simplified)
        self.update_effects(delta_time)
        
    def execute_action(self, robot: Robot, action: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Execute a robot action and return outcome."""
        outcome = {"success": False}
        
        # Movement
        if action["movement"] == "MOVE_TOWARD" and action.get("target_position"):
            target = action["target_position"]
            # Calculate direction
            direction = target - robot.position
            distance = direction.distance_to(Position(0, 0, 0))
            
            if distance > 0:
                # Normalize and move

@dataclass
class Position:
    x: float = 0.0
    y: float = 0.0
    z: float = 0.0

    def distance_to(self, other: 'Position') -> float:
        return math.sqrt((self.x - other.x)**2 + (self.y - other.y)**2 + (self.z - other.z)**2)

    def __add__(self, other: 'Position') -> 'Position':
        return Position(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y, self.z + other.z)

    def __sub__(self, other: 'Position') -> 'Position':
        return Position(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y, self.z - other.z)

    def take_damage(self, damage: float) -> bool:
        """Apply damage to robot, considering shield first."""
        if not self.alive:
            return False
            
        # Shield absorbs damage first
        if self.shield > 0:
            shield_absorbed = min(damage, self.shield)
            self.shield -= shield_absorbed
            damage -= shield_absorbed
            
        # Apply remaining damage to health
        self.health = max(0, self.health - damage)
        
        if self.health <= 0:
            self.alive = False
            logger.info(f"Robot {self.id} ({self.team.value}) has been destroyed!")
            
        return self.alive

        """Heal robot, respecting max health."""
        self.health = min(self.max_health, self.health + amount)
        
    def recharge_shield(self, amount: float):
        """Recharge shield, respecting max shield."""
        self.shield = min(self.max_shield, self.shield + amount)

        """Use ability if on cooldown."""
        if self.ability_cooldown[ability] > 0:

        cooldown_map = {

        """Update all ability cooldowns."""
        for ability in self.ability_cooldown:
            if self.ability_cooldown[ability] > 0:
                self.ability_cooldown[ability] = max(0, self.ability_cooldown[ability] - delta_time)

        """Add experience and potentially level up."""
        self.experience += xp
        # Experience required for level up increases with level

                distance = robot.position.distance_to(target_robot.position)
                if distance > 30:
                    # Use long-range weapon
                    if robot.weapon != WeaponType.SNIPER_RIFLE:
                        if robot.weapon_ammo[WeaponType.SNIPER_RIFLE] > 0:
                            action["weapon"] = WeaponType.SNIPER_RIFLE
                elif distance < 10:
                    # Use melee if available
                    if robot.weapon != WeaponType.LASER_SWORD:
                        # Check if robot type allows melee
                        if robot.robot_type == RobotType.ASSAULT:
                            action["weapon"] = WeaponType.LASER_SWORD
            
        # Add movement command
        if action["target"]:
            target_pos = None
            # If target is an enemy robot
            if action["target"] in self.robots:
                target_robot = self.robots[action["target"]]
                if target_robot.alive:
                    target_pos = target_robot.position
            # If target is an objective
            elif action["target"].startswith("objective_"):
                for obj in self.game_state.objectives:
                    if f"objective_{obj.type.value}" == action["target"]:
                        target_pos = obj.position
                        break
                        
            if target_pos:
                # Move toward target
                direction = target_pos - robot.position
                if direction.x == 0 and direction.y == 0 and direction.z == 0:
                    direction = Position(random.uniform(-1, 1), random.uniform(-1, 1), 0)
                # Normalize direction
                magnitude = math.sqrt(direction.x**2 + direction.y**2 + direction.z**2)
                if magnitude > 0:
                    direction.x /= magnitude
                    direction.y /= magnitude
                    direction.z /= magnitude
                action["movement"] = "MOVE_TOWARD"
                action["target_position"] = target_pos
                action["speed"] = 1.0 + (self.difficulty_level - 1.0) * 0.5
                
        # Add some randomness for unpredictability
        if random.random() < 0.1 * self.difficulty_level:
            # Add random ability usage
            abilities = [a for a in AbilityType if robot.ability_cooldown[a] <= 0]
            if abilities:
                action["ability"] = random.choice(abilities)
                
        return action
        
    def update_performance_history(self, robot_id: str, success: bool):
        """Record robot performance for adaptive learning."""
        self.performance_history.append({
            "robot_id": robot_id,
            "success": success,
            "timestamp": time.time()
        })
        
    def adapt_strategy(self, robot: Robot, previous_action: Dict[str, Any], outcome: Dict[str, Any]):
        """Update robot's strategy memory based on outcome."""
        # Add to memory
        robot.strategy_memory.append({
            "action": previous_action,
            "outcome": outcome,
            "timestamp": time.time()
        })
        
        # Prune old memory
        if len(robot.strategy_memory) > 50:
            robot.strategy_memory.pop(0)
            
        # Learn from experience - if action failed, avoid similar actions
        if not outcome.get("success", False):
            # Slightly reduce likelihood of repeating the same strategy
            # This is a simplified learning mechanism
            pass

        if outcome.get("success", False):
            robot.add_experience(5.0)

class CyberArena:
    """Main game engine for CyberArena."""
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.robots: Dict[str, Robot] = {}
        self.game_state = GameState()
        self.ai_controller = AIController(self.game_state, self.robots)
        self.running = False
        self.simulation_thread = None
        self.command_queue = queue.Queue()
        self.last_frame_time = time.time()
        self.frame_interval = 1.0 / 60.0  # 60 FPS
        
        # Initialize environment
        self.initialize_environment()
        
        # Initialize robots
        self.initialize_robots()
        
        # Sound and visual effects (simulated)
        self.sound_effects = {
            "shoot": "PULSE_SHOOT",
            "explosion": "EXPLOSION",
            "heal": "HEAL_SOUND",
            "powerup": "POWERUP_SOUND",
            "objective_complete": "OBJECTIVE_COMPLETE"
        }
        
        self.particle_effects = []
        
    def initialize_environment(self):
        """Initialize the arena environment with objectives, power-ups, and hazards."""
        # Create objectives
        objective_positions = [
            Position(50, 50, 0),
            Position(-50, -50, 0),
            Position(0, 80, 0),
            Position(0, -80, 0)
        ]
        
        for i, pos in enumerate(objective_positions):
            # Alternate objectives between teams
            team = Team.RED if i % 2 == 0 else Team.BLUE
            obj_type = random.choice([ObjectiveType.FLAG_CAPTURE, ObjectiveType.CONTROL_POINT])
            objective = Objective(
                type=obj_type,
                position=pos,
                team=team,
                capture_radius=15.0,
                time_required=15.0
            )
            self.game_state.objectives.append(objective)
            
        # Create power-ups
        powerup_positions = [
            Position(30, 30, 0),
            Position(-30, -30, 0),
            Position(70, 20, 0),
            Position(-70, -20, 0),
            Position(0, 0, 0)
        ]
        
        powerup_types = [
            PowerUpType.HEALTH_PACK,
            PowerUpType.AMMO_RELOAD,
            PowerUpType.SPEED_BOOST,
            PowerUpType.DAMAGE_BOOST,
            PowerUpType.INVINCIBILITY
        ]
        
        for pos in powerup_positions:
            powerup = PowerUp(
                type=random.choice(powerup_types),
                position=pos,
                respawn_time=30.0,
                time_left=30.0
            )
            self.game_state.power_ups.append(powerup)
            
        # Create environmental hazards
        hazard_positions = [
            Position(20, 0, 0),
            Position(-20, 0, 0),
            Position(0, 40, 0),
            Position(0, -40, 0)
        ]
        
        hazard_types = [
            EnvironmentHazard.ELECTRIC_FIELD,
            EnvironmentHazard.LAVA_POOL,
            EnvironmentHazard.TOXIC_GAS,
            EnvironmentHazard.MINEFIELD
        ]
        
        for pos in hazard_positions:
            hazard = EnvironmentHazardInstance(
                type=random.choice(hazard_types),
                position=pos,
                radius=8.0,
                damage_per_second=3.0
            )
            self.game_state.hazards.append(hazard)
            
        logger.info(f"Environment initialized with {len(self.game_state.objectives)} objectives, "
                   f"{len(self.game_state.power_ups)} power-ups, and {len(self.game_state.hazards)} hazards.")
        
    def initialize_robots(self):
        """Initialize robots with balanced team composition."""
        # Create 12 robots - 6 per team
        robot_types = [RobotType.ASSAULT, RobotType.SUPPORT, RobotType.SCOUT, RobotType.TANK]
        
        # Team Red
        for i in range(6):
            robot_type = robot_types[i % len(robot_types)]
            robot = Robot(
                id=f"r_red_{i}",
                team=Team.RED,
                robot_type=robot_type,
                position=Position(random.uniform(-80, -20), random.uniform(-70, 70), 0)
            )
            self.robots[robot.id] = robot
            
        # Team Blue
        for i in range(6):
            robot_type = robot_types[i % len(robot_types)]
            robot = Robot(
                id=f"r_blue_{i}",
                team=Team.BLUE,
                robot_type=robot_type,
                position=Position(random.uniform(20, 80), random.uniform(-70, 70), 0)
            )
            self.robots[robot.id] = robot
            
        logger.info(f"Initialized {len(self.robots)} robots: {len([r for r in self.robots.values() if r.team == Team.RED])} Red, {len([r for r in self.robots.values() if r.team == Team.BLUE])} Blue")
        
    def start(self):
        """Start the game simulation."""
        if self.running:
            return
            
        self.running = True
        self.game_state.round_started = True
        self.game_state.last_update = time.time()
        
        # Start simulation thread
        self.simulation_thread = threading.Thread(target=self._simulation_loop)
        self.simulation_thread.daemon = True
        self.simulation_thread.start()
        
        logger.info("CyberArena simulation started.")
        
    def stop(self):
        """Stop the game simulation."""
        self.running = False
        if self.simulation_thread:
            self.simulation_thread.join(timeout=1.0)
        logger.info("CyberArena simulation stopped.")
        
    def _simulation_loop(self):
        """Main simulation loop."""
        while self.running:
            current_time = time.time()
            delta_time = current_time - self.last_frame_time
            self.last_frame_time = current_time
            
            # Cap delta_time to prevent large jumps
            if delta_time > 0.1:
                delta_time = 0.1
                
            # Update game state
            self.update(delta_time)
            
            # Sleep to maintain frame rate
            elapsed = time.time() - current_time
            sleep_time = self.frame_interval - elapsed
            if sleep_time > 0:
                time.sleep(sleep_time)
                
    def update(self, delta_time: float):
        """Update game state for the current frame."""
        # Update time
        self.game_state.time_elapsed += delta_time
        
        # Update robot cooldowns
        for robot in self.robots.values():
            if robot.alive:
                robot.update_cooldowns(delta_time)
                
        # Update power-ups
        for powerup in self.game_state.power_ups:
            if powerup.active:
                powerup.time_left -= delta_time
                if powerup.time_left <= 0:
                    powerup.active = False
            else:
                powerup.respawn_time -= delta_time
                if powerup.respawn_time <= 0:
                    powerup.active = True
                    powerup.respawn_time = 30.0
                    powerup.time_left = 30.0
                    # Create visual effect
                    self.particle_effects.append({
                        "type": "powerup_spawn",
                        "position": powerup.position,
                        "lifetime": 2.0
                    })
                    
        # Update hazards
        for hazard in self.game_state.hazards:
            if hazard.active:
                # Apply damage to robots in hazard area
                for robot in self.robots.values():
                    if robot.alive and robot.position.distance_to(hazard.position) <= hazard.radius:
                        robot.take_damage(hazard.damage_per_second * delta_time)
                        # Create visual effect
                        self.particle_effects.append({
                            "type": "hazard_damage",
                            "position": robot.position,
                            "lifetime": 1.0
                        })
                        
        # Process AI decisions
        for robot in self.robots.values():
            if robot.alive and robot.team != Team.NEUTRAL:  # Only AI-controlled robots
                # Get action from AI
                action = self.ai_controller.make_decision(robot)
                
                # Execute action
                outcome = self.execute_action(robot, action)
                
                # Update performance history
                self.ai_controller.update_performance_history(robot.id, outcome.get("success", False))
                
                # Adapt robot strategy based on outcome
                self.ai_controller.adapt_strategy(robot, action, outcome)
                
        # Process objectives
        self.update_objectives(delta_time)
        
        # Update scoring
        self.update_scoring()
        
        # Update visual and audio effects (simplified)
        self.update_effects(delta_time)

@dataclass
class Vector2D:
    x: float = 0.0
    y: float = 0.0
    
    def __add__(self, other):
        return Vector2D(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    
    def __sub__(self, other):
        return Vector2D(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    
    def __mul__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2D(self.x * scalar, self.y * scalar)
    
    def __truediv__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2D(self.x / scalar, self.y / scalar)
    
    def magnitude(self):
        return math.sqrt(self.x**2 + self.y**2)
    
    def normalize(self):
        mag = self.magnitude()
        if mag == 0:
            return Vector2D(0, 0)
        return self / mag
    
    def distance_to(self, other):
        return (self - other).magnitude()
    
    def to_tuple(self):
        return (self.x, self.y)

@dataclass
class Objective:
    type: ObjectiveType
    position: Vector2D
    team: int = -1  # -1 means neutral, otherwise team that owns it
    captured_by: Optional[int] = None
    progress: float = 0.0  # 0.0 to 1.0
    radius: float = 80.0
    is_active: bool = True
    
    def is_captured(self) -> bool:
        return self.captured_by is not None
    
    def update_progress(self, team: int, delta: float):
        if not self.is_active:
            return
            
        # Only update progress if team is near the objective
        if self.team == -1 or self.team == team:
            self.progress = min(1.0, max(0.0, self.progress + delta))
            if self.progress >= 1.0:
                self.captured_by = team
                self.team = team
                self.progress = 1.0
        else:
            # Opposing team can reduce progress
            self.progress = max(0.0, self.progress - delta)
            if self.progress <= 0.0:
                self.captured_by = None
                self.team = -1
                self.progress = 0.0

        """Apply hazard effect to robot and return damage dealt"""
        if not self.active:

        distance = robot.position.distance_to(self.position)
        if distance <= self.radius:
            # Damage decreases with distance (inverse square)
            damage_multiplier = 1.0 - (distance / self.radius)
            damage = self.damage_per_second * damage_multiplier
            robot.health -= damage
            robot.stats["damage_taken"] += int(damage)
            return damage
        return 0.0

def distance_squared(p1: Vector2D, p2: Vector2D) -> float:
    """Calculate squared distance between two points (faster than sqrt)"""
    dx = p1.x - p2.x
    dy = p1.y - p2.y
    return dx*dx + dy*dy

def find_nearest_robot(robots: List[Robot], position: Vector2D, exclude_team: Optional[int] = None) -> Optional[Robot]:

    nearest_robot = None

        if exclude_team is not None and robot.team == exclude_team:

        distance = robot.position.distance_to(position)
        if distance < min_distance:
            min_distance = distance
            nearest_robot = robot
            
    return nearest_robot

            return Vector2D(0, 0)
        return self / mag
    
    def distance_to(self, other):
        return (self - other).magnitude()
    
    def as_tuple(self):
        return (int(self.x), int(self.y))

@dataclass
class Robot:
    id: int
    team: int  # 0 or 1
    position: Vector2D
    velocity: Vector2D = field(default_factory=lambda: Vector2D(0, 0))
    health: float = 100.0
    max_health: float = 100.0

            }
        # Initialize default weapon
        self.weapon = Weapon(WeaponType.RANGED, damage=25, range=300, fire_rate=0.5)

@dataclass
class Weapon:
    type: WeaponType
    damage: float
    range: float
    fire_rate: float  # seconds between shots
    ammo: int = 50
    max_ammo: int = 50
    reload_time: float = 2.0
    reload_progress: float = 0.0
    is_reloading: bool = False
    
    def can_fire(self, time_since_last_shot: float) -> bool:
        return time_since_last_shot >= self.fire_rate and not self.is_reloading and self.ammo > 0
    
    def fire(self):
        if self.can_fire(0):
            self.ammo -= 1
            self.reload_progress = 0.0
            self.is_reloading = self.ammo <= 0
            return True
        return False
    
    def reload(self, delta_time: float):
        if self.is_reloading and self.reload_progress < self.reload_time:
            self.reload_progress += delta_time
            if self.reload_progress >= self.reload_time:
                self.ammo = self.max_ammo
                self.is_reloading = False

class PowerUp:

@dataclass
class Objective:
    type: str  # "flag", "payload", "base"
    position: Vector2D
    team: int  # which team owns it
    captured: bool = False
    capture_progress: float = 0.0  # 0.0 to 1.0
    capture_rate: float = 0.01  # per second per robot
    defenders: Set[int] = field(default_factory=set)  # robot IDs defending
    attackers: Set[int] = field(default_factory=set)   # robot IDs attacking
    
    def update_capture(self, robots: List[Robot], delta_time: float):
        """Update capture progress based on robots near objective"""
        team_robots = [r for r in robots if r.team == self.team and r.is_alive]
        enemy_robots = [r for r in robots if r.team != self.team and r.is_alive]
        
        # Count robots near objective
        friendly_near = sum(1 for r in team_robots if r.position.distance_to(self.position) < 80)
        enemy_near = sum(1 for r in enemy_robots if r.position.distance_to(self.position) < 80)
        
        # Capture rate is influenced by number of robots
        if friendly_near > 0 and enemy_near == 0:
            self.capture_progress += self.capture_rate * friendly_near * delta_time
        elif enemy_near > 0 and friendly_near == 0:
            self.capture_progress -= self.capture_rate * enemy_near * delta_time
        elif friendly_near > 0 and enemy_near > 0:
            # Neutralize if both teams are present
            self.capture_progress += self.capture_rate * (friendly_near - enemy_near) * delta_time
        
        # Clamp progress
        self.capture_progress = max(0.0, min(1.0, self.capture_progress))
        self.captured = self.capture_progress >= 1.0

        self.large_font = pygame.font.SysFont('Arial', 32)

        # Render map (simple grid with objectives)

        # Render objectives
        for obj in game_state.objectives:
            self._render_objective(obj)

                self._render_powerup(pu)

            if robot.is_alive:

                self._render_effect(effect)

            HazardType.FLAME_SPOT: RED,
            HazardType.GRAVITY_WELL: PURPLE,

        }
        
        color = color_map.get(hazard.type, GRAY)

    def _render_effect(self, effect: Effect):

        if effect.type == "explosion":

        elif effect.type == "trail":

        elif effect.type == "shield":

class ParticleSystem:
    """Manages particle effects for explosions, trails, etc."""
    def __init__(self):
        self.particles = []
    
    def add_particle(self, x: float, y: float, color: Tuple[int, int, int], size: float, lifetime: float, velocity: Vector2D):
        self.particles.append({
            'position': Vector2D(x, y),
            'velocity': velocity,
            'color': color,
            'size': size,
            'lifetime': lifetime,
            'timer': 0.0
        })
    
    def update(self):
        for particle in self.particles[:]:
            particle['position'] += particle['velocity']
            particle['timer'] += 1/FPS
            particle['size'] *= 0.98  # Fade out
            if particle['timer'] >= particle['lifetime']:
                self.particles.remove(particle)
    
    def render(self, screen):
        for particle in self.particles:
            alpha = int(255 * (1 - particle['timer'] / particle['lifetime']))
            color = particle['color'] + (alpha,)
            pos = particle['position'].as_tuple()
            size = max(1, int(particle['size']))
            pygame.draw.circle(screen, color, pos, size)

# ===============================
class AIController:
    """Main AI controller for robot behavior"""
    def __init__(self, game_state: GameState, visual_system: VisualSystem):
        self.game_state = game_state
        self.visual_system = visual_system
        self.last_update = 0
        self.memory_buffer = deque(maxlen=100)  # Stores recent battle data for learning
    
    def update(self, delta_time: float):
        """Update all robots' AI behaviors"""
        self.last_update += delta_time
        
        # Adjust difficulty based on performance
        self._adjust_difficulty()
        
        # Update AI for each alive robot
        for robot in self.game_state.robots:
            if not robot.is_alive:
                continue
            
            # Determine if robot is performing an objective
            self._determine_objective(robot)
            
            # Update strategy based on memory
            self._update_strategy(robot, delta_time)
            
            # Execute behavior based on role and current situation
            self._execute_behavior(robot, delta_time)
            
            # Update cooldowns and weapon reload
            if robot.weapon:
                robot.weapon.reload(delta_time)
                robot.cooldown = max(0, robot.cooldown - delta_time)
        
        # Update objectives
        for obj in self.game_state.objectives:
            obj.update_capture(self.game_state.robots, delta_time)
            if obj.captured:
                self._handle_objective_capture(obj)
        
        # Process power-ups and hazards
        self._update_powerups(delta_time)
        self._update_hazards(delta_time)
        
        # Handle team scoring and feedback
        self._update_team_statistics()
        
        # Handle learning feedback loop
        self._learn_from_battles()
    
    def _adjust_difficulty(self):
        """Adjust AI difficulty based on team performance"""
        red_score = self.game_state.score[0]
        blue_score = self.game_state.score[1]
        total_rounds = len(self.game_state.match_history)
        
        # If one team is dominating, increase difficulty for that team
        if total_rounds > 3:
            if abs(red_score - blue_score) > 3:
                # Increase difficulty for leading team
                if red_score > blue_score:
                    self.game_state.difficulty_level = min(1.0, self.game_state.difficulty_level + 0.02)
                else:
                    self.game_state.difficulty_level = min(1.0, self.game_state.difficulty_level + 0.02)
            else:
                # Balance difficulty
                self.game_state.difficulty_level = max(0.1, self.game_state.difficulty_level - 0.005)
        
        # Normalize difficulty between 0.1 and 1.0
        self.game_state.difficulty_level = max(0.1, min(1.0, self.game_state.difficulty_level))
    
    def _determine_objective(self, robot: Robot):
        """Assign or update robot's objective based on team needs"""
        # If robot has no objective, assign one
        if not robot.objective:
            objectives = [obj for obj in self.game_state.objectives if not obj.captured]
            if not objectives:
                return  # All objectives captured
            
            # Find nearest objective
            nearest_obj = min(objectives, key=lambda obj: robot.position.distance_to(obj.position))
            obj_type = nearest_obj.type
            
            # Assign role-based objective
            if robot.role == Role.ATTACKER:
                robot.objective = f"capture_{obj_type}"
            elif robot.role == Role.DEFENDER:
                robot.objective = f"defend_{obj_type}"
            elif robot.role == Role.SUPPORT:
                robot.objective = "heal_teammates" if self._has_low_health_teammate(robot) else f"capture_{obj_type}"
            elif robot.role == Role.Scout:
                robot.objective = f"scout_{obj_type}"
    
    def _has_low_health_teammate(self, robot: Robot) -> bool:
        """Check if any teammate has low health"""
        teammates = [r for r in self.game_state.robots if r.team == robot.team and r.is_alive and r.id != robot.id]
        return any(t.health < t.max_health * 0.3 for t in teammates)
    
    def _update_strategy(self, robot: Robot, delta_time: float):
        """Update robot's strategy based on learning from previous battles"""
        # Every 5 seconds, analyze performance and adapt
        if self.last_update > 5.0:
            # Calculate recent success rate
            recent_success = 0
            recent_actions = 0
            
            # In a real system, this would analyze memory of past actions
            # For now, simulate based on performance
            if robot.strategy_memory:
                recent_actions = len(robot.strategy_memory[-10:])
                recent_success = sum(1 for m in robot.strategy_memory[-10:] if m.get('success', False))
            
            success_rate = recent_success / recent_actions if recent_actions > 0 else 0.5
            
            # Adjust skills based on success
            if success_rate > 0.7:
                # Improve skills if doing well
                for skill in robot.skills:
                    robot.skills[skill] = min(0.95, robot.skills[skill] + 0.005)
            elif success_rate < 0.3:
                # Reduce overconfidence if doing poorly
                for skill in robot.skills:
                    robot.skills[skill] = max(0.4, robot.skills[skill] - 0.005)
            
            # Adapt role based on performance
            self._adapt_role(robot)
            
            # Reset timer
            self.last_update = 0
    
    def _adapt_role(self, robot: Robot):
        """Dynamically adapt robot's role based on performance and team needs"""
        # Collect data on robot's performance
        kills = sum(1 for m in robot.strategy_memory if m.get('action') == 'kill')
        assists = sum(1 for m in robot.strategy_memory if m.get('action') == 'assist')
        objectives = sum(1 for m in robot.strategy_memory if m.get('action') in ['capture', 'escort'])
        
        # Define thresholds for role change
        if kills > 5 and assists < 2 and objectives < 1:
            robot.role = Role.ATTACKER
        elif assists > 3 and kills < 3 and objectives > 0:
            robot.role = Role.SUPPORT
        elif objectives > 3 and kills < 2:
            robot.role = Role.DEFENDER
        elif kills > 2 and assists > 2 and objectives > 1:
            robot.role = Role.Scout  # Balanced role
        else:
            # Default to attacker if no clear pattern
            robot.role = Role.ATTACKER
        
        # Track role changes
        robot.team_role_history.append(robot.role)
        if len(robot.team_role_history) > 20:
            robot.team_role_history.pop(0)
    
    def _execute_behavior(self, robot: Robot, delta_time: float):
        """Execute robot's behavior based on its role, objective, and environment"""
        if not robot.is_alive:
            return
        
        # Get teammates and enemies
        teammates = [r for r in self.game_state.robots if r.team == robot.team and r.is_alive and r.id != robot.id]
        enemies = [r for r in self.game_state.robots if r.team != robot.team and r.is_alive]
        
        # Get nearest objective
        objectives = [obj for obj in self.game_state.objectives if not obj.captured]

class ParticleSystem:
    """Manages particle effects for explosions, trails, etc."""
    def __init__(self):
        self.particles = []
    
    def add_particle(self, x: float, y: float, color: Tuple[int, int, int], size: float, lifetime: float, velocity: Vector2D):
        self.particles.append({
            'position': Vector2D(x, y),
            'velocity': velocity,
            'color': color,
            'size': size,
            'lifetime': lifetime,
            'timer': 0.0
        })
    
    def update(self):
        for particle in self.particles[:]:
            particle['position'] += particle['velocity']
            particle['timer'] += 1/FPS
            particle['size'] *= 0.98  # Fade out
            if particle['timer'] >= particle['lifetime']:
                self.particles.remove(particle)
    
    def render(self, screen):
        for particle in self.particles:
            alpha = int(255 * (1 - particle['timer'] / particle['lifetime']))
            color = particle['color'] + (alpha,)
            pos = particle['position'].as_tuple()
            size = max(1, int(particle['size']))
            pygame.draw.circle(screen, color, pos, size)

    def __init__(self, game_state: GameState, visual_system: VisualSystem):
        self.game_state = game_state
        self.visual_system = visual_system
        self.last_update = 0
        self.memory_buffer = deque(maxlen=100)  # Stores recent battle data for learning
    
    def update(self, delta_time: float):
        """Update all robots' AI behaviors"""
        self.last_update += delta_time
        
        # Adjust difficulty based on performance
        self._adjust_difficulty()
        
        # Update AI for each alive robot
        for robot in self.game_state.robots:
            if not robot.is_alive:
                continue
            
            # Determine if robot is performing an objective
            self._determine_objective(robot)
            
            # Update strategy based on memory
            self._update_strategy(robot, delta_time)
            
            # Execute behavior based on role and current situation
            self._execute_behavior(robot, delta_time)
            
            # Update cooldowns and weapon reload
            if robot.weapon:
                robot.weapon.reload(delta_time)
                robot.cooldown = max(0, robot.cooldown - delta_time)
        
        # Update objectives
        for obj in self.game_state.objectives:
            obj.update_capture(self.game_state.robots, delta_time)
            if obj.captured:
                self._handle_objective_capture(obj)
        
        # Process power-ups and hazards
        self._update_powerups(delta_time)
        self._update_hazards(delta_time)
        
        # Handle team scoring and feedback
        self._update_team_statistics()
        
        # Handle learning feedback loop
        self._learn_from_battles()
    
    def _adjust_difficulty(self):
        """Adjust AI difficulty based on team performance"""
        red_score = self.game_state.score[0]
        blue_score = self.game_state.score[1]
        total_rounds = len(self.game_state.match_history)
        
        # If one team is dominating, increase difficulty for that team
        if total_rounds > 3:
            if abs(red_score - blue_score) > 3:
                # Increase difficulty for leading team
                if red_score > blue_score:
                    self.game_state.difficulty_level = min(1.0, self.game_state.difficulty_level + 0.02)
                else:
                    self.game_state.difficulty_level = min(1.0, self.game_state.difficulty_level + 0.02)
            else:
                # Balance difficulty
                self.game_state.difficulty_level = max(0.1, self.game_state.difficulty_level - 0.005)
        
        # Normalize difficulty between 0.1 and 1.0
        self.game_state.difficulty_level = max(0.1, min(1.0, self.game_state.difficulty_level))
    
    def _determine_objective(self, robot: Robot):
        """Assign or update robot's objective based on team needs"""
        # If robot has no objective, assign one
        if not robot.objective:
            objectives = [obj for obj in self.game_state.objectives if not obj.captured]
            if not objectives:
                return  # All objectives captured
            
            # Find nearest objective
            nearest_obj = min(objectives, key=lambda obj: robot.position.distance_to(obj.position))
            obj_type = nearest_obj.type
            
            # Assign role-based objective
            if robot.role == Role.ATTACKER:
                robot.objective = f"capture_{obj_type}"
            elif robot.role == Role.DEFENDER:

            elif robot.role == Role.SUPPORT:

            elif robot.role == Role.Scout:
                robot.objective = f"scout_{obj_type}"

        return any(t.health < t.max_health * 0.3 for t in teammates)

@dataclass
class Vector2D:
    """2D vector for position, velocity, and direction."""
    x: float = 0.0
    y: float = 0.0
    
    def __add__(self, other):
        return Vector2D(self.x + other.x, self.y + other.y)
    
    def __sub__(self, other):
        return Vector2D(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)
    
    def __mul__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2D(self.x * scalar, self.y * scalar)
    
    def __truediv__(self, scalar):
        return Vector2D(self.x / scalar, self.y / scalar)
    
    def length(self):
        return math.sqrt(self.x**2 + self.y**2)
    
    def normalize(self):
        length = self.length()
        if length == 0:
            return Vector2D(0, 0)
        return self / length
    
    def distance_to(self, other):
        return (self - other).length()
    
    def to_tuple(self):
        return (self.x, self.y)

def generate_random_position(arena_size: Vector2D, min_distance: float = 20.0, 
                           exclude_positions: List[Vector2D] = None) -> Vector2D:
    """Generate a random position in arena, avoiding excluded positions."""
    if exclude_positions is None:
        exclude_positions = []
    
    attempts = 0
    max_attempts = 100
    while attempts < max_attempts:
        x = random.uniform(min_distance, arena_size.x - min_distance)
        y = random.uniform(min_distance, arena_size.y - min_distance)
        pos = Vector2D(x, y)
        
        # Check distance from all excluded positions
        valid = True
        for excluded in exclude_positions:
            if pos.distance_to(excluded) < min_distance:
                valid = False
                break
        
        if valid:
            return pos
        attempts += 1
    
    # Fallback: return a random position if we couldn't find a good one
    return Vector2D(
        random.uniform(min_distance, arena_size.x - min_distance),
        random.uniform(min_distance, arena_size.y - min_distance)
    )

class AIController:
    """Handles AI decision-making for robots."""
    
    def __init__(self, game_state: GameState, robot: Robot):
        self.game_state = game_state
        self.robot = robot
        self.last_decision_time = 0
        self.decision_cooldown = 0.5  # seconds between major decisions
        self.current_target: Optional[int] = None  # Target robot ID
        self.current_objective: Optional[Objective] = None
        self.behavior_tree = self._build_behavior_tree()
        
    def _build_behavior_tree(self) -> List:
        """Build a simple behavior tree for decision making."""
        return [
            self._check_alive,
            self._check_objective_completion,
            self._assess_team_status,
            self._seek_powerup,
            self._engage_enemy,
            self._defend_base,
            self._patrol,
            self._retreat
        ]
    
    def _check_alive(self) -> bool:
        """Check if robot is alive."""
        return self.robot.is_alive
    
    def _check_objective_completion(self) -> bool:
        """Check if objective is completed or needs attention."""
        if not self.game_state.objective:
            return False
            
        # If robot is carrying payload and objective is destination, complete it
        if (self.game_state.objective.type == ObjectiveType.ESCORT_PAYLOAD and 
            self.game_state.objective.is_carried and 
            self.robot.id == self.game_state.objective.carrier_id):
            distance_to_target = self.robot.get_distance_to(self.game_state.objective.position)
            if distance_to_target < 10:  # Close enough to complete
                self.game_state.objective.is_active = False
                self.game_state.team_scores[self.robot.team] += 50
                self.robot.strategy_history.append({
                    "action": "completed_objective",
                    "objective": self.game_state.objective.type.value,
                    "time": self.game_state.time_elapsed
                })
                return True
                
        # If robot is not on team controlling objective, go to capture it
        if (self.game_state.objective.team is not None and 
            self.game_state.objective.team != self.robot.team and
            self.robot.get_distance_to(self.game_state.objective.position) < 100):
            self.current_objective = self.game_state.objective
            return True
            
        return False
    
    def _assess_team_status(self) -> bool:
        """Assess team's status and adjust role accordingly."""
        team_members = [r for r in self.game_state.robots if r.team == self.robot.team and r.is_alive]
        if len(team_members) == 0:
            return False
            
        # Count enemy robots
        enemy_robots = [r for r in self.game_state.robots if r.team != self.robot.team and r.is_alive]
        total_enemies = len(enemy_robots)
        
        # If team is heavily outnumbered, switch to defensive role
        if len(team_members) <= total_enemies / 2:
            if self.robot.role != RobotRole.DEFENDER:
                self.robot.role = RobotRole.DEFENDER
                self.robot.strategy_history.append({
                    "action": "role_change",
                    "from": self.robot.role.value,
                    "to": RobotRole.DEFENDER.value,
                    "reason": "outnumbered"
                })
        # If team has strong advantage, become more aggressive
        elif len(team_members) >= total_enemies * 1.5:
            if self.robot.role != RobotRole.ATTACKER:
                self.robot.role = RobotRole.ATTACKER
                self.robot.strategy_history.append({
                    "action": "role_change",
                    "from": self.robot.role.value,
                    "to": RobotRole.ATTACKER.value,
                    "reason": "advantage"
                })
                
        return False
    
    def _seek_powerup(self) -> bool:
        """Seek and acquire power-ups."""
        if not self.game_state.powerups:
            return False
            
        # Find closest power-up
        closest_powerup = None
        min_distance = float('inf')
        
        for powerup in self.game_state.powerups:
            if not powerup.active:
                continue
            distance = self.robot.get_distance_to(powerup.position)
            if distance < min_distance and distance < self.robot.perception_radius:
                min_distance = distance
                closest_powerup = powerup
        
        if closest_powerup:
            # Move toward power-up
            direction = (closest_powerup.position - self.robot.position).normalize()
            self.robot.velocity = direction * min(MAX_VELOCITY, self.robot.get_distance_to(closest_powerup.position) * 0.3)
            
            # If close enough, collect power-up
            if min_distance < 10:
                self._apply_powerup(closest_powerup)
                closest_powerup.active = False
                # Create visual effect
                self.game_state.particles.append(
                    Particle(
                        position=closest_powerup.position,
                        velocity=Vector2D(random.uniform(-1, 1), random.uniform(-1, 1)),
                        color="#FFFF00",
                        life=0.8,
                        size=5,
                        type="powerup"
                    )
                )
                self.robot.strategy_history.append({
                    "action": "collected_powerup",
                    "powerup": closest_powerup.type.value,
                    "time": self.game_state.time_elapsed
                })
                return True
                
        return False
    
    def _apply_powerup(self, powerup: Powerup):
        """Apply power-up effects to robot."""
        if powerup.type == PowerupType.HEALTH_PACK:
            self.robot.heal(powerup.value)
        elif powerup.type == PowerupType.AMMO_PACK:
            self.robot.add_ammo(int(powerup.value))
        elif powerup.type == PowerupType.SPEED_BOOST:
            # This is handled by velocity scaling in update_physics
            self.robot.strategy_history.append({
                "action": "speed_boost",
                "duration": powerup.duration,
                "time": self.game_state.time_elapsed
            })
        elif powerup.type == PowerupType.SHIELD:
            self.robot.armor = min(self.robot.armor + powerup.value, 80)
        elif powerup.type == PowerupType.INSTA_KILL:
            # This is a temporary state, will be checked during attack
            self.robot.strategy_history.append({
                "action": "insta_kill_enabled",
                "duration": powerup.duration,
                "time": self.game_state.time_elapsed
            })
        elif powerup.type == PowerupType.TELEPORT:
            # Teleport to a random location
            new_pos = generate_random_position(self.game_state.arena_size, exclude_positions=[self.robot.position])
            self.robot.position = new_pos
            self.robot.velocity = Vector2D()
            self.robot.strategy_history.append({
                "action": "teleported",
                "to": (new_pos.x, new_pos.y),
                "time": self.game_state.time_elapsed
            })
    
    def _engage_enemy(self) -> bool:
        """Engage closest enemy robot."""
        enemies = [r for r in self.game_state.robots if r.team != self.robot.team and r.is_alive]
        if not enemies:
            return False
            
        # Find closest enemy
        closest_enemy = min(enemies, key=lambda e: self.robot.get_distance_to(e.position))
        distance = self.robot.get_distance_to(closest_enemy.position)
        
        if distance < self.robot.perception_radius:
            self.current_target = closest_enemy.id
            self.robot.last_seen_enemies.append(closest_enemy.id)
            
            # Calculate movement direction
            direction = (closest_enemy.position - self.robot.position).normalize()
            move_speed = min(MAX_VELOCITY, distance * 0.5)
            self.robot.velocity = direction * move_speed
            
            # Check if we can attack
            if self._can_attack(closest_enemy):
                self._attack_target(closest_enemy)
                return True
                
            return True
            
        return False
    
    def _can_attack(self, target: Robot) -> bool:
        """Check if robot can attack target."""
        if not self.robot.weapon or not self.robot.weapon.can_fire():
            return False
            
        distance = self.robot.get_distance_to(target.position)
        if distance > self.robot.weapon.range:
            return False
            
        # Check if target is in front (simple cone check)
        if distance <= 10:  # Melee range
            return True
            
        # For ranged weapons, check angle
        angle_to_target = self.robot.get_angle_to(target.position)
        # Simplified: assume robot is facing the direction of movement
        if self.robot.velocity.length() > 0.1:
            current_angle = math.atan2(self.robot.velocity.y, self.robot.velocity.x)
            angle_diff = abs(angle_to_target - current_angle)
            # Allow 45 degrees cone
            if angle_diff > math.pi / 4:

    """Update physics for all robots and objects."""
    # Update robot physics

            continue

        # Apply friction
        robot.velocity.x *= FRICTION
        robot.velocity.y *= FRICTION
        
        # Limit velocity
        if robot.velocity.length() > MAX_VELOCITY:
            robot.velocity = robot.velocity.normalize() * MAX_VELOCITY
            
        # Update position
        robot.position = robot.position + (robot.velocity * delta_time)

        if robot.position.x < 0:
            robot.position.x = 0
            robot.velocity.x *= -0.5
        elif robot.position.x > game_state.arena_size.x:
            robot.position.x = game_state.arena_size.x
            robot.velocity.x *= -0.5

            robot.velocity.y *= -0.5
        elif robot.position.y > game_state.arena_size.y:

        if not powerup.active:

        powerup.position.y += 0.5 * delta_time  # Slow drift down
